brief: The terminal is live. Key the number and read its verdict back.
epilogue: Marquee Hardware is dark when you pass it.

memos.subject: PERSONAL — RENT
memos.text: Your pay is unchanged this quarter while the rooming-house rate has gone up again. The staff Chargex deduction remains attached to card 4490-0017-2231. Head office does not consider either item a systems matter.

rulebook.text: Decline any card number appearing in the current hot card bulletin.
Decline any charge that would put an account over its credit limit.
A charge at or under floor limit should not be called in. If it is, decline and note it.
Decline the second of two drafts from one merchant on one card within one shift (split draft).
Key every call into the terminal and relay its verdict.
Where terminal and desk disagree, the terminal stands.

calls.note: Voice is subtly not Elliot Marche's. Same cadence, wrong man. Callback: Marche is at a funeral across the water.

items.head: DEATHS
items.body: MARCHE — Suddenly, at the hospital across the water, April 14, Wilhelmina MARCHE, mother of Elliot Marche of Marquee Hardware. Funeral Monday. The store will be closed.
